blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Manila Water Philippine Ventures (MWPV), the Non-East Zone subsidiary of Manila Water, continues to strengthen water supply resilience in North Luzon through proactive investments and operational measures undertaken by its operating units, Calasiao Water in Pangasinan and Metro Ilagan Water in Isabela. Pagasa has identified both provinces as vulnerable to dry conditions and dry spells through the remainder of 2026, with the risk of drought persisting into the first quarter of 2027. In Pangasinan, Calasiao Water has reinforced its readiness to sustain reliable water service through a comprehensive service continuity plan aimed at securing water availability and minimizing […]...
